document:4:675:0.text:
How to Make a Disguise-Removing Potion:
Crush <style="highlight">soulblooms</style>, <style="highlight">glimmerfern</style>, and <style="highlight">rotbuds</style>, then simmer them in a cauldron until the mixture thickens.
Note: This recipe is the exclusive property of the Adamant Syndicate. Do not share it with outsiders!
document:4:675:0.source_cn:
伪装魔法解除药剂的制作方法：
捣碎<style="highlight">晨魂草</style>、<style="highlight">镜蕨</style>、<style="highlight">腐枝中芽</style>，放入锅中炼制成浓稠液体。
注：此配方专利为黑金商会独有，不可外传！
